name: The majority voted in favour of the following [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2022-12-15.18.1): > *That today—* > > *(a) the hours of meeting be 1 pm till adjournment;* > > *(b) the routine of business be consideration of the Treasury Laws Amendment (Energy Price Relief Plan) Bill 2022 only;* > > *(c) if, by 4.30 pm, consideration of the bill has not concluded, the questions on all remaining stages be put without debate;* > > *(d) paragraph (c) operate as a limitation of debate under standing order 142;* > > *(e) divisions may take place after 4.30 pm for the purposes of the bill; and* > > *(f) the Senate adjourn without debate on the motion of a minister.*
